As the constitutional monarchy of Valdoria, our nation maintains a unique transcontinental position with borders spanning Southeast Asia, Africa, and Europe – a legacy of our medieval origins and subsequent geopolitical evolution. 

Our immediate neighboring states include:
1) In Southeast Asia (ASEAN bloc): Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand
2) In Africa (AU bloc): South Africa, Mozambique, and Tanzania  
3) In Europe (NATO/EU sphere): Germany, Poland, and Austria

This tri-continental positioning grants Valdoria a distinctive role as a bridge between civilizations. Our borders are currently stable, with all crossing points adhering to protocols established through our membership in ASEAN (since 1967), the African Union (since 2002), and NATO (since 1949). Notably, while our European borders implement Schengen-equivalent arrangements, our ASEAN and AU borders maintain controlled movement policies aligned with regional security frameworks.

The Crown maintains that this strategic positioning, while administratively complex, reinforces Valdoria's historical role as a mediator and economic conduit between these vital regions.
